# LVGL sources

The `lvgl/` directory contains the library source, public headers, CMake support, and license from [LVGL v9.6.0](https://github.com/lvgl/lvgl/releases/tag/v9.6.0). The upstream archive has SHA-256 `b20ee3acc1bba13c62d854f9ebd62e4c51e0b443b1e0225892e86442defa84df`.

The main CMake build, `UICreator.sln`, and the integration tests use this local copy. The previous snapshot is retained under `legacy/lvgl/` for the legacy source paths.
